title: Motorized macro focus rail
engineering: A 240 µm pre-roll and 6 µm capture schedule cover 0.60 mm with 57.81% worst modeled focal overlap.
physical_check: Measure actual reversal clearance, settling and step repeatability under mounted load with a displacement gauge. Run a 101-exposure stack at the selected lens setting and check overlap, focus breathing, vibration, trigger timing and travel stops.

title: Manual XY specimen stage
engineering: Squaring the second slide to 0.12° nominal skew reduces the modeled cross-axis drift from 0.55 to 0.099 mm.
physical_check: Measure actual carriage squareness, lash, screw pitch and repeatability with a dial indicator. Inspect specimen retention, clamp and lens clearance through all four travel corners.

title: Hand-pushed tabletop camera dolly
engineering: A 25.2° steering setting gives a 309.73 mm modeled turning radius and 15.90 mm support reserve.
physical_check: Measure real wheel contact and loaded center of mass. Check curves, wheel scrub, floor transitions, steering play and frame vibration with a noncritical payload.

title: Camera cable strain-relief clamp
engineering: Increasing the nominal cable-path radius to 23 mm leaves 20.4 mm on the largest cable's inside surface and retains 0.20–0.60 mm modeled pad interference.
physical_check: Measure the actual cage threads, cable diameter, manufacturer bend requirement and connectors. Use a pull gauge to verify that force reaches the cage and the padding leaves the cable and ports undamaged.

title: Camera half cage for one body
engineering: Trimming the bottom plate keeps all three modeled access zones open, with 4.5 mm clearance at the closest door sweep.
physical_check: Measure the actual camera and three-dimensional motions, including the articulated display. Verify anti-twist features, connector insertion travel, fastener depth, door access and bracket retention before putting a camera in service.

title: Manual lens follow-focus wheel
engineering: Reducing carriage offset to 0.13 mm lowers modeled lens reversal play from 0.910° to 0.345° and retains 1.483 contact ratio.
physical_check: Measure chosen lens diameters and any gear installed, check print or cutter tolerance, run contact-blue and mesh-backlash checks at the tight and loose ends, and test focusing torque and marked repeatability without binding.

title: Portable reflector sail
engineering: A 0.448 kg centered ballast increases the model's restoring-to-disturbance moment ratio from 1.26 to 2.92.
physical_check: Measure stand socket size and footprint, verify that ballast cannot shift, and check stable tipping and slip behavior against an actual tabletop draft before using it next to equipment.

title: Single-roll tabletop backdrop winder
engineering: A 24 mm effective brake contact radius supplies 1.79–5.25 N modeled paper tension and no more than 4.8 N estimated crank force.
physical_check: Measure chosen paper width, roll radius, bracket and table clamp range. Confirm breakaway and running friction with a spring scale, hand force, roll retention and wear after repeated cycles.

title: Collapsible chroma panel
engineering: Extending adjustable strap cut length to 500 mm keeps fitted strain between 4.4% and 14.2% across both chair routes.
physical_check: Fit the straps to the agreed chair, confirm the chair remains stable and move through fold cycles. Compare wrinkles and key quality under actual side lighting and check elastic creep.

title: Low-profile desk microphone arm
engineering: Raising the spring anchor above the pivot reduces modeled residual torque from 1.20 to 0.394 N·m through the working range.
physical_check: Measure real center of mass and spring stroke, then proof and cycle the clamp, lock and pivot using an expendable load. Check release and cable clearance through the full arm articulation.

title: Clip-on speech pop screen
engineering: A 52 mm aperture radius and an 11 mm mesh gap preserve 12.28 mm of modeled source-cone clearance and 64 mm to the diaphragm.
physical_check: Compare recorded plosive peaks and in-band speech attenuation against recordings without a screen at identical gain. Check flex-neck range and clamp strength on the actual stand.

title: Microphone suspension cradle
engineering: The softer cord setting reduces modeled 30 Hz motion transmission from 0.232 to 0.061 and retains 20.66 mm of static travel reserve.
physical_check: Check cord force-displacement with a spring scale, center the mic with cable attached, and measure impulse and sinusoidal transmission through the working orientation before making performance claims.

title: Folding vocal reflection screen
engineering: Increasing each wing to 163 mm raises the geometric rear coverage half-angle from 84.56° to 99.33°.
physical_check: Compare impulse records with and without the screen, inspect off-axis coloration and desk reflection, then verify hinge friction and stowed fit.

title: Monitor-speaker isolation wedges
engineering: Matched wedges with a 24 mm height differential across 170 mm produce 8.04° tilt and at least 8 mm seating inset.
physical_check: Measure the actual speaker feet, load and center of mass. Verify foam compression, height matching, stability on the desk and transfer vibration at working volume.
